title: Electronic Pliers and Nippers - Nomenclature
clause_1_scope: This Standard covers the nomenclature of pliers and nippers for electronics. The pliers and nippers may be supplied with or without return springs or sleeves. The cutting nippers may be supplied with a safety device ( e.g. lead catcher ). NOTE — The figures in this Standard are given as examples only and are not intended to affect the manufacturer's design.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
